title: Workspace, Members and Organization
case_ids_frozen_by: P12 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P12-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.scope: Close P12 Workspace/Folders-Tags/campaign-governance/notification-core only; inherit P07 analytics; P15 identity lifecycle and P13-P17 notification producers remain later-owned.

rules: Remaining P12 API paths are P12 implementation authority, not IA-exact.
No /app/folders route or legacy alias.
P12 APP-SETTINGS ownership is /app/settings/workspace only; P15 owns profile/security/sessions/connected-accounts.
No user-facing arbitrary-notification producer API.
All P12 Workspace APIs/routes: authenticated, server tenant/RBAC, noindex, no-store, no sitemap.

identity_rbac_contract.identity: Consume current authenticated principal only; P12 does not claim P15 identity/session/OAuth. Test auth may supply actor identity in CI only.
identity_rbac_contract.membership: Every P12 request re-resolves Workspace membership/role from MySQL; X-GoJet-Test-Workspace-Role/client role is never P12 authorization.
rules: owner full P12 authority but last active owner protected
admin manages workspace/org/campaign/tag/folder and admin/member/viewer, never owner
member reads context and manages campaign/tag/folder/link organization, never settings/members/invites
viewer read-only
invitation grants admin/member/viewer only; owner promotion requires existing owner
cross-workspace denial must not disclose existence
invitation inspection is authentication-gated and never discloses raw invited email, token hash or token existence to an unauthenticated caller
mutable records use optimistic concurrency; stale write 409
tag/folder normalized uniqueness is per Workspace
campaign ID is the same P07 analytics campaign_id namespace
Link organization is same-Workspace and bulk mutations use explicit Link IDs
invitation raw token is never persisted/logged; store cryptographic hash only
authenticated invitation inspection exposes only safe Workspace/name/role/status/expiry/account-match metadata; raw invited email and token hash stay private
internal producer only
recipient+dedupe_key idempotency
read_at recipient scoped
allowlisted registered deep links reauthorized at read
unauthorized deep link omitted or /app/notifications
secret/PII/provider/risk redaction
read state may be optimistic but security/billing/resource facts may not
complete/partial/stale are explicit

browser_contract.shell: Switcher/Command/Notifications support Esc, focus return, mobile full-height Sheet, no overlay stacking; evidence includes canonical viewports, 320px and reduced motion.

environment_contract.identity: current principal + MySQL membership/role; test role header non-authoritative
environment_contract.p05: reuse P05 Links for organization/filter evidence
environment_contract.browser: built Workspace/Auth routes with real APIs

cases.name: Workspace create/list/context
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Create Workspace + owner atomically; list only actor memberships; client switch cannot grant membership.

cases.name: Workspace metadata versioning
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Owner/admin validated update; member/viewer deny; stale expected_version 409.

cases.name: Server-side four-role matrix
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: MySQL membership role, never client/test role header, authorizes owner/admin/member/viewer.

cases.name: Cross-workspace isolation
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Known foreign IDs cannot enumerate or mutate P12 data; denial semantics do not leak existence.

cases.name: Role mutation/removal
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Admin cannot grant/touch owner; member/viewer cannot manage roles; no self-escalation.

cases.name: Invitation create/list/revoke
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Invite admin/member/viewer only; owner invite rejected; normalized duplicate safe; raw token not persisted.

cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.

cases.name: Last-owner invariant
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.
cases.oracle: Zero-owner transition rejected transactionally including concurrent mutations.

cases.name: Organization metadata
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P12 authority and fixtures required by the case.

cases.name: Campaign continuity

cases.name: Audit/redaction
